snippet.title: WILL: Follow the Light - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
An exclusive developer interview with the team behind WILL: Follow the Light - an intriguing, story-driven, first-person adventure-puzzler game about a perilous personal journey, coming soon to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #willfollowthelight
